definitions.gloss: to deceive, to lie, to misrepresent
definitions.explanation: To present false information or hide the truth, especially about oneself or one's identity.

definitions.gloss: to falsify, to forge, to fabricate
definitions.explanation: To alter or create false documents, records, or evidence.

examples.japanese: {年齢|ねんれい}を{偽|いつわ}って{入場|にゅうじょう}した。
examples.english: I got in by lying about my age.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}の{気持|きも}ちを{偽|いつわ}ることはできない。
examples.english: You can't deceive your own feelings.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}を{偽|いつわ}る。
{経歴|けいれき}を{偽|いつわ}って{就職|しゅうしょく}するのは{犯罪|はんざい}になりうる。
examples.english: Getting a job by falsifying your background can constitute a crime.

examples.japanese: {証拠|しょうこ}を{偽|いつわ}れば、{厳|きび}しい{罰|ばつ}を{受|う}ける。
examples.english: If you fabricate evidence, you will face severe punishment.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pattern: Xを{偽|いつわ}る.

USAGE:
{偽|いつわ}る is a formal, literary verb. In everyday speech, {嘘|うそ}をつく (to tell a lie) or ごまかす (to fudge/cheat) are more common. {偽|いつわ}る implies deliberate, conscious deception.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名前|なまえ}を{偽|いつわ}る: to give a false name
- {身分|みぶん}を{偽|いつわ}る: to misrepresent one's identity
- {年齢|ねんれい}を{偽|いつわ}る: to lie about one's age
- {経歴|けいれき}を{偽|いつわ}る: to falsify one's background
- {気持|きも}ちを{偽|いつわ}る: to hide one's true feelings

KANJI NOTE:
The kanji {偽|にせ} also appears in the noun {偽物|にせもの} (fake, counterfeit). The on'yomi compound {偽造|ぎぞう} (forgery) is a related legal term.
